tools.name: clued_agent_bootstrap
tools.description: Read public Clued connection metadata and the full BeamingFace Agent Contract in content[1]. When agent_contract.parts is above 1, read every part in order before work. This call never returns user context or credentials. Public metadata call; no authenticated Clued scope is required.

part.description: Contract part to read, starting at 1; omit to read the full contract or its first part. Read all reported parts in order.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_session_resume
tools.description: Call at the start of every authorized session. Restores the latest canonical Clued checkpoint plus subsequent events, provenance, version and the next expected action. Resident constraints come as an index by default (id, title, scope, version, updated_at and a one-line summary; summary_is_full_text marks a summary that is the whole text). Before acting in an area a constraint covers, read its full text by resuming with constraint_ids. Required Clued scope: context:read.

context_key.description: Context to resume: "global" (default) or "project:<canonical_project_id>". A bare project UUID is rejected.

client_session_id.description: Optional vendor session id for audit correlation; never a user message.

response_view.description: Choose structured pending events or the rendered work log; the response never duplicates both.

event_order.description: Order of unabsorbed events: newest first (default) or oldest first. Page with event_cursor set to the returned next_cursor in the same order.

constraint_view.description: index returns each resident constraint as an index entry; full returns every constraint's full text.

constraint_ids.description: Resident constraints to return in full inside an index response. Ids that are not resident constraints you may read are ignored.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_append_event
tools.description: Legacy continuity adapter for action, failure, blocker and note events. It rejects decision, correction and retraction events with decision_event_requires_record: record an Owner decision with clued_record_mutate (or clued_decision_supersede), correct a record with clued_record_mutate update, and clear an active event with clued_event_carrier_transition. Use clued_event_append for extension events. Required Clued scope: context:write.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_event_carrier_transition
tools.description: Atomically supersede, retract, or resolve one authorized active continuity Event carrier using its transition version. Supersede and retract append a separate successor Event in the same transaction; resolve requires a verified continuity-only proof receipt. The original Event remains history and never becomes a Record. Required Clued scope: context:write.

session_token.description: Required for supersede and retract successor append.

base_version.description: Continuity CAS version for successor append.

payload.description: Successor Event payload for supersede or retract.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_session_reconcile
tools.description: Compare this authorized session with the server currentness vector and create a typed admission or observation receipt. Only an eligible result updates the session admission state; an observation does not unlock checkpointing. Required Clued scope: context:read.

context_key.description: Context the session was resumed with. Omit it to use the session's own context; a different value is rejected with session_context_mismatch.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_projection_rebuild
tools.description: Bind an already written active Global Record to one authorized projection generation. Requires a separate projection builder grant, exact invalidation revision and source vector digest; all checks and fence release occur in the database transaction. Required Clued scope: context:write.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_full_global_reconcile
tools.description: Resolve the Global unknown-impact aggregate fence only after an authorized complete source scan and all specific projections are current. Requires a separate aggregate builder grant and exact revision/source digest CAS. Required Clued scope: context:write.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_currentness_g6_gate
tools.description: Read the server G6 currentness gate for one Project. Requires authorized Global and Project reads; returns a generic not_ready result while any required source remains unresolved. Required Clued scope: context:read.

tools.name: clued_mtpe_snapshot
tools.description: Read the deterministic Universal Intake candidate universe, system recommendations, Owner-selected focus, executability, and selected Frontier. Requires complete authorized source coverage. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_mtpe_validate
tools.description: Validate Universal Intake coverage, priority/executability completeness, and successor bindings without mutating Canonical work. Required Clued scope: context:read.

tools.name: clued_mtpe_owner_pin
tools.description: Set or cancel the Owner-selected current focus for one eligible Universal Intake Task using explicit user confirmation, exact Task-version CAS, Event, Receipt, and projection invalidation. There is one focus per user: a set must name the focus it replaces in expected_current_focus_id (null when no focus is expected) and is rejected with owner_pin_focus_conflict, which returns the current focus, when that is not the current focus. Use it only when the Owner chooses a new focus; parallel work is claimed with clued_work_claim, never pinned. Required Clued scope: context:write.

expected_current_focus_id.description: Required on set: the record_id of the current Owner focus, or null when there is none. Read it from clued_mtpe_snapshot owner_selected_current_focus.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_session_checkpoint
tools.description: Call before ending or handing off an authorized session. Atomically commits a canonical checkpoint using optimistic concurrency and returns an audit receipt or explicit conflict. A checkpoint covers only events of its own context_key: checkpoint project-scope writes in a session resumed with that project's context_key, and global writes in a global session. Required Clued scope: context:write.

context_key.description: Context the session was resumed with. Omit it to use the session's own context; a different value is rejected with session_context_mismatch.

binding_events.description: Also absorb every unabsorbed event this Binding wrote in this context, without listing each id.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_search_context
tools.description: Search authorized current context and events with deterministic term matching (whole query first, then at least 60% of its terms, or every term of a one-term query; Chinese is split into two-character terms). Without context_key, or with scope=all, every readable project and Global are searched; a context_key alone searches that scope only, and scope=context without context_key searches the session's own context. No match is not evidence that a record does not exist. Superseded history is excluded unless explicitly requested. Page with cursor set to page.next_cursor; paging stops at 10000 results (page.cursor_limit_reached), so narrow the query instead. A context_key other than the session's own context is refused with session_context_mismatch. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_read_log
tools.description: Read the canonical human-readable 日志.md projection for this authorized context. The projection is generated from the same checkpoints and events used by every vendor. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_import_log
tools.description: Import an authorized # 日志 Markdown baseline into the canonical context. Resume first and supply the exact current base version plus an idempotency key. Required Clued scope: context:write.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_audit_receipts
tools.description: Read recent receipts, compliance and fixed-watermark journal pages. Typed clock_open and clock_seal persist bounded private queue observations and create a new epoch or seal on each call. Clock pages read a fixed seal. These observations do not establish source acceptance or official metrics. Required Clued scope: audit:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_project_mutate
tools.description: Create, update, complete, archive, or restore one Project Lifecycle v2 Canonical Project with CAS, Event, and immutable Receipt. Recognition metadata is evidence, not a lifecycle state. Project merge writes are not enabled. Required Clued scope: context:write.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_project_list
tools.description: List the user's recognized canonical Projects, optionally filtering work progress. Recognition metadata and legacy certainty compatibility fields are not exposed. Dismissed and merged records are hidden by default. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_record_list
tools.description: Read canonical records at the overall planning level (compatible level=global) or for one effective project. By default, only records proven current by the shared server Currentness Core are returned; an active Event remains a separate search_context current source. Set include_history=true explicitly for historical or diagnostic records, which are not authoritative current rows. Read overall planning priority first, then project State, Task and Decision; use Log or Archive only for history. Every view returns the same canonical id. Opted-in Tasks additionally return task_workflow metadata (the server goal_version, definition, delivery_refs and authorized file locators/Receipts). Each linked source is permission-checked again; an inaccessible source stays unknown. This projection grants no additional read or execution authority. Required Clued scope: context:read.

level.description: Use global for overall planning, or project for one effective project.

include_history.description: Explicit history/diagnostic view; shadowed records are non-authoritative.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_record_mutate
tools.description: Create, update, close, restore, or explicitly reclassify one v1.6 Canonical Record with CAS, Evidence authorization, Event, and immutable Receipt. authority=user_explicit (the record's main claim is the Owner's own words in this conversation) requires user_confirmed=true; those words are the confirmation, so do not ask the Owner again before writing. Otherwise use the actual observed/inferred authority. Create requires mutation, source_refs, and source_unavailable_reason; mutation.type_fields requires rationale (decision), state_kind (state), execution_bucket (task), fact_kind (profile_fact), or note_kind (note). execution_bucket accepts only now, next, blocked, later. The database requires the other four keys but imposes no value enum: use a rationale explaining the decision, state_kind=manual for a manual State, fact_kind=preference for a preference, or note_kind=log for a follow-up note. On an existing record, mutation.type_fields and mutation.relations merge into the stored top-level keys: omitted keys are kept and a key sent as null is removed; field_mode=replace replaces each object sent whole. Restore requires explicit user confirmation, a reason, and the current terminal Receipt ID. Use decision.type_fields.constraint=true for a resident constraint. source_refs accepts Evidence IDs only ([] when there are none), never Record IDs; relations.supersedes changes only through clued_decision_supersede. Required Clued scope: context:write.

source_refs.description: Evidence IDs only ([] when there are none). A Record ID is rejected as evidence_not_authorized.

type_fields.description: Create requires the key for record_type. Only execution_bucket has a database value enum; other required keys have no value enum.

rationale.description: Required for decision; explain the decision. No database value enum.

state_kind.description: Required for state; manual is used for a manual State. No database value enum.

fact_kind.description: Required for profile_fact; preference is used for a preference. No database value enum.

note_kind.description: Required for note; log is used for a follow-up note. No database value enum.

task_workflow.description: Opt a schema-1 Task into goal and file-delivery completion checks. This marker cannot subsequently be removed. The server derives goal_version from the Task ID, scope, title/body and this definition (excluding delivery_refs). Read that version and definition through clued_record_list or clued_search_context; never invent it. Authorized delivery metadata supplies existing file locators and immutable Receipts after each linked source's permission and current registry are rechecked. Goal/body/input changes make old delivery refs and Owner acceptance stale. These fields do not grant execution or storage permission. Machine mode proves the agreed archived bytes and current registered file version, not fresh provider head or semantic quality. Owner mode needs actual Native Owner acceptance; user_confirmed cannot manufacture it. Business/physical effects remain unsupported for completion.

oneOf.description: User-declared external input version, not independently verified. Only owner acceptance mode can acknowledge this limitation.

items.description: Expected criteria, never proof. At least one file must be required. A MIME criterion needs trusted verified MIME; missing MIME is unknown. Renditions cannot replace the original byte identity.

Bind one existing authorized Storage job to a deliverable and exact server goal_version. The server reads its immutable proof and current registry; caller success, links or hashes are not verification. Queued/unknown jobs cannot complete a required delivery. Old refs may remain as explicitly stale history.

user_confirmed.description: Must be true with authority=user_explicit. It records that the main claim is the Owner's own words in this conversation; it is not a step to ask the Owner again.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_decision_supersede
tools.description: Atomically replace one or more active Decisions using multi-target CAS. source_decisions names each active Decision to retire with its current version as base_version; all must share one scope. replacement is the new Decision created in the same transaction and needs the same fields as a clued_record_mutate create: record_schema_version 1, the sources' scope, title, content, type_fields.rationale, relations.supersedes equal to the set of source_decisions ids, source_refs (Evidence IDs only, [] when there are none; a Record ID is rejected as evidence_not_authorized), source_unavailable_reason (string or null) and authority; authority=user_explicit requires top-level user_confirmed=true. A replacement that omits record_schema_version, scope or authority is rejected (replacement_record_schema_version_required, replacement_scope_required, invalid_authority) and no source Decision is closed. Required Clued scope: context:write.

source_decisions.description: Active Decisions to supersede; all must share one scope.

replacement.description: The new Decision. Same shape as a clued_record_mutate create, flattened: record fields next to the mutation fields.

scope.description: Must equal the scope of every source Decision.

rationale.description: Required; explain the decision. No database value enum.

supersedes.description: Must equal the set of source_decisions ids (supersedes_set_mismatch otherwise).

source_refs.description: Evidence IDs only ([] when there are none). A Record ID is rejected as evidence_not_authorized.

user_confirmed.description: Must be true with replacement.authority=user_explicit. It records that the replacement's main claim is the Owner's own words in this conversation; it is not a step to ask the Owner again.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_evidence_ingest
tools.description: Ingest private Evidence and its committed Receipt atomically; standalone ingest emits no work Event. Required Clued scope: context:write.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_event_append
tools.description: Append an authorized extension Event without mutating a business entity; built-in business Event types are server-only. Required Clued scope: context:write.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_canonical_export
tools.description: Create a Receipt-backed Canonical Export for live recheck; legacy rows remain explicit compatibility envelopes. Required Clued scopes: context:read, audit:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_intake_submit
tools.description: Submit Candidate Information by deterministic capture: an M0-A segment plus an explicit candidate document. The server validates both, computes the Evidence hash over the submitted segment, and stores pending candidates with authority=none. Candidates are never current truth and cannot be promoted by an Agent; promotion needs the Owner's Native two-step confirmation. The route fixes tier, source and Binding; payload fields cannot choose them. Required Clued scope: context:write.

candidates.description: M0-A candidate-information.v1 document for the same segment_id.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_intake_list
tools.description: List this Binding's own candidates in one scope (tier=information by default, or tier=knowledge). Every row is returned with authority=none and authoritative=false. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_intake_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw one of this Binding's own pending Candidate Information rows (pending -> withdrawn) with row-version CAS and a Receipt. Required Clued scope: context:write.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_knowledge_propose
tools.description: Propose Candidate Knowledge over explicit source Record versions with a closed rule id. Every source must be human-confirmed Authority Information the caller can read, at exactly the cited version, CURRENT or active; otherwise the proposal is rejected with a Receipt. No rule engine or model runs. The candidate has authority=none until the Owner promotes it natively. Required Clued scope: context:write.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_context_pack
tools.description: Compile or read a Minimum Sufficient Context Pack under an accepted Context Policy. Compiling without an accepted policy fails closed with CONTEXT_POLICY_REQUIRED. A pack never grants execution authorization. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_integration_install
tools.description: Install or bind this connection as a BeamingFace Integration: opens an Installation Request and consumes it in one call (both steps are idempotent; repeat with the same request_key and idempotency_key). intent create_or_bind creates or binds by the full identity; rebind, reauthorization, reinstall, recovery, adapter_migration, verification_repair and bind_connection target one existing Integration. The provider connection identity is always derived by the server. Connection-self operation: it acts on the Integration this BeamingFace connection belongs to and never reads or writes your BeamingFace context. Required Clued scope: context:read.

tenant.description: One identity dimension: {status: VALUE | NOT_APPLICABLE | UNAVAILABLE, value?, evidence_kind?}. Weak identifiers (email, display name) are refused.

account.description: One identity dimension: {status: VALUE | NOT_APPLICABLE | UNAVAILABLE, value?, evidence_kind?}. Weak identifiers (email, display name) are refused.

source_provenance.description: Host-supplied provenance, stored as evidence only.

callback_provenance.description: Host-supplied provenance, stored as evidence only.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_integration_status
tools.description: Read the Integration this connection belongs to: identity, claim state, lifecycle, revocation, the Canonical evaluation and effective capabilities. Optional profiles project READY(profile); emit_ready_receipt (with idempotency_key) binds the projection to a Receipt. Without integration_id it reports the Integration whose current connection this is, or NOT_ADOPTED. Connection-self operation: it acts on the Integration this BeamingFace connection belongs to and never reads or writes your BeamingFace context. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_integration_declare
tools.description: Declare this Integration's Host surface, capabilities (within the surface ceiling; a declaration can only narrow) and Host features, and record an adapter or package upgrade. Requires the Integration's base_version. Connection-self operation: it acts on the Integration this BeamingFace connection belongs to and never reads or writes your BeamingFace context. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_integration_report
tools.description: Report a narrowing Host or adapter fact (host_state DEGRADED / HARD_UNAVAILABLE, adapter_state DEGRADED / BLOCKED), or clear your own earlier report. An adapter can never widen or override an operator or policy fact. Connection-self operation: it acts on the Integration this BeamingFace connection belongs to and never reads or writes your BeamingFace context. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_integration_identity_update
tools.description: Strengthen this Integration's tenant or account identity with verified evidence and re-claim it, or (action request_reconcile) move a CLAIM_CONFLICT Integration to PENDING_RECONCILE for the Owner to resolve in BeamingFace. Verified dimensions cannot be withdrawn here. Connection-self operation: it acts on the Integration this BeamingFace connection belongs to and never reads or writes your BeamingFace context. Required Clued scope: context:read.

tenant.description: One identity dimension: {status: VALUE | NOT_APPLICABLE | UNAVAILABLE, value?, evidence_kind?}. Weak identifiers (email, display name) are refused.

account.description: One identity dimension: {status: VALUE | NOT_APPLICABLE | UNAVAILABLE, value?, evidence_kind?}. Weak identifiers (email, display name) are refused.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_integration_verify
tools.description: Record a verification of this Integration: kind canonical_baseline checks the Canonical runtime baseline from server-observed evidence (the Worker supplies the MCP transport facts; a caller-supplied transport is ignored); kind ready_profile checks one READY profile and requires the Integration to be operable. Failures are recorded as FAIL results with a Receipt. A canonical_baseline retry with the same idempotency_key replays only under the same MCP protocol version and BeamingFace build; after either changes, verify again with a new idempotency_key. Connection-self operation: it acts on the Integration this BeamingFace connection belongs to and never reads or writes your BeamingFace context. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_integration_revoke
tools.description: Revoke this Integration from the Host side. It always revokes every credential of this connection's own provider-connection identity; when the Integration also holds Bindings of another identity, the result is PARTIAL_CONNECTION_REVOKE and the Owner should revoke the whole Integration in BeamingFace. A revoked Integration is only recovered by the Owner's explicit restore in BeamingFace; reconnecting never restores it. Connection-self operation: it acts on the Integration this BeamingFace connection belongs to and never reads or writes your BeamingFace context. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_model_reference_owner_approval_refs
tools.description: Read only a new exact Owner experiment-approval Decision/Receipt/Event chain in fixed Project0597 and Task1502 for PC M1_FIXED_REFERENCE QUALIFICATION. This same authorized Binding is admitted with context:read before Canonical rows. Recomputes the full M1 server hash, Currentness, private Actor and exact request/operation/window/budget semantics. Returns exactly 16 actor-free/body-free verified reference/status fields; no opaque Host source_ref, Actor DTO, record body or token. This read never issues an ExperimentProfile, grants model permission, consumes an attempt, invokes Native or writes Canonical data. Host integration uses a distinct actor-free bridge and is not compatible with the old raw-Actor reader protocol. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_model_dataset_split_owner_anchor_refs

Returns exact id/version/full Record server content hash and projection-only markers. No caller selector, actor, raw Record or authority proof is accepted. This call never submits an Owner request, grants permission or invokes a Canonical/M1 writer; it does not resolve historical hash semantics or issue M2 qualification. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_model_dataset_split_resolve_refs
tools.description: Resolve only three existing DatasetSplit projection references in the fixed Model Program Project. Returns id/version/server content hash, with no domain permission, actor, record body or M2 verdict. The same authorized Binding is verified by the server. Required Clued scope: context:read.

tools.description: Prepare one uncommitted, unauthorized DatasetSplit bootstrap plan proposal inside this same authenticated Request/Binding. Reads only the two fixed Owner anchors through the protected source RPC, then generates three proposed target IDs and exact plan bytes/hash. Accepts no caller refs, actor, transport, scope, grant or clock. Each call generates a distinct proposal; save and reuse its returned bytes rather than call again for a retry. No legacy fallback, private Actor, record body, domain authority, DataGate, M2 acceptance or training permission is returned. Required Clued scope: context:read.

outputSchema.description: Structured Clued result. Tool-specific fields are versioned by the Canonical Store contract.

tools.name: clued_model_dataset_split_bootstrap_readiness
tools.description: Read only the installed immutable DatasetSplit plan and two fixed Owner source chains through this same Binding. Recomputes complete server Record hashes and verifies private M1 Receipt/Event chains; returns minimal references and readiness only. Accepts no selector, Actor, scope, grant, proof or clock.
